sn45.20:1.2: “Friend Ānanda, it is said, ‘the holy life, the holy life.’
sn45.20:1.3: What now, friend, is the holy life, and who is a follower of the holy life, and what is the final goal of the holy life?”
sn45.20:1.5: Your intelligence is excellent, friend Bhadda, your ingenuity is excellent, your inquiry is a good one. For you have asked me:
sn45.20:1.7: ‘Friend Ānanda, it is said, “the holy life, the holy life.” What now, friend, is the holy life, and who is a follower of the holy life, and what is the final goal of the holy life?’” “Yes, friend.”
sn45.20:1.10: “This Noble Eightfold Path, friend, is the holy life; that is,
sn45.20:1.12: One who possesses this Noble Eightfold Path is called a liver of the holy life.
sn45.20:1.14: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
sn45.20:1.15: this, friend, is the final goal of the holy life.”
